name: grill-me (listed as grilling)
short: Questions you hard about a plan, round by round, until every open decision is settled.
what: A skill that interviews you about a plan, decision or idea. It maps the decisions as a tree, asks every question it can ask right now in one numbered round, suggests an answer for each and waits for yours. It looks facts up itself instead of asking you, and stops when nothing is left open. The repo has renamed it from grilling to grill-me. It's adapted from Matt Pocock's grilling skill (MIT).
who: Anyone about to start a feature, project or big decision who wants the gaps found before work begins. It won't write code or act on the plan.
needs: Node.js for `npx`, or Claude Code for the plugin route

steps.title: In Claude Code, install the Dev Loop bundle
Or install the whole collection
steps.text: This adds all 169 skills for the three agents named. Don't use `--all`, which installs to every agent the CLI knows (30+).
steps.code: npx skills add shipshitdev/skills -g --agent claude-code codex cursor --skill '*' -y

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text:
grill me on this plan: <paste your plan>

("interview me" also works.)

watch: It may start a read-only sub-agent to look up facts in your files or tracker. It doesn't edit code or write to trackers.
It stops at a shared understanding and waits for you to confirm before anything is acted on.
The repo's old `scripts/install-skills.sh` installer was removed. The README says not to run an old copy.
